$comment: Scaffold manifest for open-beta-probe (chief-wiggum#256). apply_pattern.py stamps each file into the target repo with parameters bound ({{param}} in target path and body). These are EXPERIMENT scaffolds, not product code: a blast-radius declaration, a signup-code metering stub, and a binding README the operator wires and launches after pre-registering the test card (assumption.py). Existing targets are skipped unless --force. blast_radius is a REQUIRED parameter with no default (INV-OBP-004) — without it bound, the contract pack still installs but this scaffold is skipped with a note, per the standard apply_pattern.py rule for missing required params.

files.desc: The declared blast-radius record: bounded|unbounded and the resulting live|compute-only mode. Stamping is refused without blast_radius bound.
Signup-code metering stub: issue/redeem/revoke unique per-cohort codes against {{code_issuance_endpoint}}; wiring TODO stated in-file.

Binding note: declare the blast radius before requesting codes; pre-register the assumption.py test card at strength 3-4 BEFORE the beta opens; the reputation-is-single-use and push-motion sequencing rules.
